scope: Certify D59 saved CM point-to-root correspondence using D106 marked rigidity, exact normalizers, rational root disks, field norms and a finite monomial-rank certificate; no actual differential evaluation.

sources.title: John Voight, Computing CM points on Shimura curves arising from cocompact arithmetic triangle groups
sources.use: Explicit ideal/Artin action convention: iota(a)O=xi O gives z -> xi^(-1)z. Only underlying reciprocity is used; not triangle parametrization or the paper's separate Q-descent assertions.

sources.title: John Voight, Shimura curve computations
sources.use: Canonical CM reciprocity over general totally real F and the F-defined normalizer quotient. Reuses D59 exact CM class labels.

sources.title: Terence Tao, Math 246A Notes 4: singularities of holomorphic functions
sources.use: Classical root count. Project-specific integer bounds compare the linear term at each rational center with its Taylor remainder.

sources.title: Don Blasius and Lucio Guerberoff, Complex conjugation and Shimura varieties
sources.use: Context for canonical complex conjugation. The project identifies its explicit antiholomorphic map by D106 marked rigidity instead; the CM-reflex-field descent theorem is not applied.

sources.title: SageMath, ideals of number fields
sources.use: Produces a principal generator witness. Independent rational checks verify the resulting unit, inverse, normalizer and anticommutator rather than trusting principalization alone.

local_sources.use: Actual saved matrix embedding, including both off-diagonal signs; necessary for the sign of the CM complex embedding.
Aut(C_Qbar,D)=1, compatible Q-descent and unique residue-field isomorphism.
Concrete CM class field H of degree 272, full affine group, gamma generating the degree-16 CM subfield, and exact resolvent.
Saved exact CM ideal labels, order and elliptic embeddings. Its approximate orientation/root-order checks are superseded, not treated as certified input.

project_deductions: Any antiholomorphic D-marked automorphism equals canonical conjugation by D106 rigidity.
An exact positive order unit U makes U^(-1)I anticommute with the reference beta; this fixes point8 and proves it is the unique real CM point.
Rational Sturm/square intervals prove the Rickards lower-left coefficient negative, selecting beta=-i*sqrt(2+b).
Eighteen rational Rouche disks and an integer norm bound prove kappa_f=gamma exactly.
Rank271 of the 272 ordered-pair root monomials makes distinct directed 17-cycle sums distinct; the stabilizer of gamma then proves the proposed cycle is Galois.
Independent Hensel lifts modulo31^8 identify arithmetic Frobenius at beta=19, whose saved ideal class is3, giving the exact old lookup.
excluded_inferences: No trust in D59 complex GaloisGroupConjugation root-index comparison.
No actual Shimura tangent, higher jet, G12 nonvanishing, or numerical differential-bank error bound.
No candidate identification, downstream branch marking identification, cubic section reconstruction or target field polynomial.
Root refinement is not a restart of spectral or cubic precision work.
